world.title: Pakistan asks US for $10bn lifeline to shore up struggling economy: Report
world.summary: Pakistan has requested a $10 billion exchange stabilization facility from the United States to support its struggling economy. This initiative aims to bolster the country's foreign exchange reserves amid ongoing economic challenges. A source familiar with the matter confirmed the request, highlighting the urgency of Pakistan's financial situation as it seeks assistance to stabilize its economic conditions.

world.title: More than 140 dead, missing on refugee boat stranded off Mauritania
world.summary: A boat carrying migrants and refugees from Africa has run out of fuel off the coast of Mauritania, resulting in at least 143 individuals dead or missing. The United Nations refugee agency, UNHCR, reported that 38 people were rescued from the tragedy. The agency expressed deep sadness over the incident, highlighting the ongoing risks faced by migrants.

world.title: Trump says US has no interest in Iran talks as cost of war increases
world.summary: The United States conducted its 11th consecutive night of strikes on Iran, as Tehran intensified its offensive against Gulf states. In response to the escalating conflict, Pakistan increased diplomatic efforts to revive the collapsed interim agreement between the two nations. Despite the ongoing hostilities, Trump stated that the US has no interest in engaging in talks with Iran.

business.title: Bandhan Bank shares tumble 15% post Q1 results; here’s why the stock crashed despite healthy earnings
business.summary: Bandhan Bank shares fell 15% on July 22, driven by investor concerns over the management's conservative outlook and margin issues, despite reporting healthy earnings for the April to June quarter. The decline occurred during early market hours as stakeholders reacted to the cautious guidance provided by the bank's leadership, overshadowing the positive financial results.

business.title: Bira 91 founder Ankur Jain exits after settlement with lenders; says company needs fresh capital
business.summary: Ankur Jain, founder of Bira 91's parent company B9 Beverages, has resigned from his board and executive positions following a settlement with lenders and investors. This decision aims to facilitate the company's restructuring and secure new capital. Bira 91 faced financial difficulties and disputes with creditors, which led to proceedings before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT).

business.title: Sensex falls 700 pts, Nifty below 24,000: Higher crude prices among key factors behind market decline
business.summary: The Sensex dropped 700 points, while the Nifty fell below 24,000, reflecting a significant market decline. This downturn is attributed to rising Brent crude prices, which reached their highest levels since June 11. The increase in crude prices is linked to escalating tensions in West Asia, contributing to investor concerns and impacting market performance.

technology.title: NASA estimates nuclear Mars mission at $2.1B
technology.summary: NASA's planned nuclear-powered mission to Mars is estimated to cost around $2.1 billion, according to a report by Politico. This figure does not include the expenses related to the scientific project that will be sent to the planet. The mission aims to advance exploration efforts and enhance understanding of Mars, marking a significant investment in space exploration.

technology.title: Google Pixel 11 India Launch: Leaked Specs, Expected Price, and Everything We Know
technology.summary: Google will launch the Pixel 11 series in India on August 12, 2026. Leaked specifications include detailed information about chip codenames and other features. The upcoming flagship is generating significant anticipation as more details emerge ahead of its release. Pricing information remains unconfirmed, but expectations are building as the launch date approaches.

technology.title: Apple Upgrade program is coming next week with up to 36-month payment plans
technology.summary: Apple is set to launch the Apple Upgrade program next week, offering device leasing options with payment plans of up to 36 months. This new program, developed in partnership with Klarna, will replace the existing iPhone Upgrade Program. A soft credit check will be required for participants, and the program is designed to function like a subscription service.

sports.title: Rohit Sharma Still Has Unfinished Business
sports.summary: Rohit Sharma, known as "The Hitman," reflects on his missed opportunity for World Cup glory in 2011. As he approaches the ODI World Cup, there is a sense that his illustrious career deserves a final celebration. While many anticipate his last performance at Lord's, Sharma remains focused on achieving success in the upcoming tournament, seeking redemption.

sports.title: Spain's World Cup dynasty begins? Early look at the favourites, challengers and biggest questions for 2030
sports.summary: As discussions about the 2030 World Cup begin, Spain emerges as a leading contender following their recent successes. While the 2026 tournament has just concluded, analysts are already evaluating favorites, challengers, and key questions for the upcoming event. The anticipation surrounding Spain's potential dominance highlights the excitement and unpredictability inherent in international football competitions.

sports.title: Is Rodri The Man Real Madrid Need?
sports.summary: Real Madrid is considering Rodri as a potential addition to their squad following his impressive performance as Spain's captain in the World Cup final against Argentina. Despite skepticism surrounding his fit within the team, many believe Rodri's skills could significantly enhance Real Madrid's midfield. The club's decision will depend on various factors, including team dynamics and financial considerations.

health.title: CDSCO Approves India's First Dengue Vaccine For People Aged 4 To 60
health.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) has approved Takeda's Qdenga, marking India's first dengue vaccine. The vaccine is authorized for use in individuals aged 4 to 60 years, aiming to enhance dengue prevention and control efforts in the country. This approval represents a significant advancement in public health measures against dengue fever in India.

health.title: Quality sleep key to protecting brain health amid rising screen time, say neurologists
health.summary: Neurologists emphasize that quality sleep is crucial for brain health, particularly as screen time rises. They warn that chronic stress and irregular sleep patterns can lead to cognitive decline and increase the risk of neurological disorders. Prioritizing good sleep hygiene may help mitigate these risks and support overall cognitive function in an increasingly digital world.

health.title: 6 dementia symptoms that can show up years before diagnosis: Early warning signs you shouldn't ignore
health.summary: Dementia symptoms can appear years before a formal diagnosis, often starting with emotional, sensory, or physical changes rather than memory loss. Experts highlight signs like mood swings, sleep issues, altered walking, unusual smell changes, or behavioral shifts. While having one symptom doesn’t guarantee dementia, persistent signs, especially with risk factors, warrant attention for early intervention and management.

science.title: NASA estimates nuclear Mars mission at $2.1B
science.summary: NASA's planned nuclear-powered mission to Mars is estimated to cost around $2.1 billion, according to a report by Politico. This figure does not include the expenses associated with the scientific project that will be sent to the planet. The mission aims to advance exploration and research on Mars, highlighting NASA's ongoing commitment to space exploration initiatives.

science.title: Rare pair of improbably light ‘super-puff’ planets is discovered
science.summary: Astrophysicists have discovered two rare gas giants, termed "super-puff" planets, which possess a density lower than cotton candy. This finding aims to enhance understanding of the extreme and unusual processes involved in planet formation. Researchers emphasize the importance of grasping the complete narrative of planet formation and evolution to further comprehend the complexities of planetary systems in the universe.

science.title: New study into humans' closest ape relatives suggests physical touch can promote social harmony
science.summary: A study by Durham University suggests that physical touch plays a significant role in promoting social harmony among humans and their closest ape relatives, bonobos and chimpanzees. The research indicates that touch may serve as an evolutionary tool to manage social tension and maintain peace within groups, highlighting its importance in social interactions among these species.

entertainment.title: Aamir Khan's stepbrother Hyder Ali Khan struggles even for food and lives in chawl, reveals his ex-wife Eva Grover
entertainment.summary: Eva Grover, the ex-wife of Hyder Ali Khan, Aamir Khan's stepbrother, disclosed their troubled marriage, alleging physical abuse. She recounted an incident where Hyder assaulted her just three days after their wedding, leaving her bruised and traumatized. Grover also mentioned that Hyder's increasing jealousy led to further complications in their relationship, impacting their lives significantly.

entertainment.title: Brand New Day' Final Trailer Shows Tom Holland Swinging With Zendaya & Closer Look At Mark Ruffalo's Hulk
entertainment.summary: The final trailer for "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" has been released, showcasing action-packed scenes. Tom Holland's Peter Parker takes center stage, highlighting his journey. The trailer also features Zendaya and offers a closer look at Mark Ruffalo's Hulk character. Fans can expect an exciting cinematic experience as the film approaches its release date.

entertainment.title: SCOOP: Aamir Khan opts out of Ashneer Grover biopic over creative differences; Rahul Mody and Shraddha Kapoor on hunt for a new actor
entertainment.summary: Aamir Khan has decided to withdraw from the biopic of Ashneer Grover due to creative differences. The film, directed by debutant Rahul Mody, was anticipated to explore Grover's controversial life as a start-up entrepreneur. Following Khan's exit, Mody and producer Shraddha Kapoor are now searching for a new actor to take on the lead role in the project.
